title: Pink Halloween Party Decor
intro: Halloween does not have to be black and orange to count. Hot pink pumpkins, ghost print tablecloths and tall pink candles make a table people photograph before they eat. Spooky is optional. Cute is the point.

images.alt: Overhead photo of a pink ghost print tablecloth with hot pink pumpkins, pink, purple and black balloons, a sheet of ghost window clings and four hot pink taper candles.
